name: claude-chat-mobile
description: Mobile chat UI that bridges your local claude CLI to your phone — terminal-equivalent agent access (resume, streaming output, on-device tool approvals).
author: Ike-li (https://github.com/Ike-li)

scripts.check: eslint . && node tests/gates/check-import-boundaries.js && node tests/gates/contract-check.js && node scripts/doc-consistency.js && node tests/gates/check-diagram-claims.js && node tests/gates/check-n1-assumptions.js && node tests/gates/i18n-check.js && node tests/gates/check-destructive-deletes.js && node tests/gates/check-shell-pitfalls.js && node tests/gates/check-invariant-ids.js && node tests/gates/check-disposable-env-guard.js && node tests/gates/check-playwright-forbidden-patterns.js && node scripts/app-build.js --test-only && npm run inventory:check
scripts.test:docker: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test sh -lc "npm run test:unit && npm run test:invariants && npm run test:invariants:server && npm run test:invariants:env && npm run test:integration"
scripts.test:docker:unit: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test npm run test:unit
scripts.test:docker:integration: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test npm run test:integration
scripts.test:docker:invariants: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test sh -lc "npm run test:invariants:server && npm run test:invariants:env"
scripts.test:docker:e2e: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:docker:sh: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm test bash
scripts.mutate:docker: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.test.yml run --rm mutate npm run mutate --
scripts.playground:up: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml up --build -d --wait && docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml logs --tail=80 app
scripts.playground:up:mock: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml --profile mock up --build -d --wait && docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml logs --tail=80
scripts.playground:up:proxy: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml --profile proxy up --build --force-recreate -d --wait && docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml logs --tail=80
scripts.playground:sh: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml exec app bash
scripts.playground:device: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml exec app node scripts/device.js
scripts.playground:doctor: docker compose -f tests/infra/docker-compose.playground.yml exec app node scripts/doctor.js
